experiments.reason: Synthetic case identifiers disclosed target category in input text.
experiments.resolution: Frozen triage-v3 uses neutral opaque identifiers independent of labels; leakage regressions added. The unchanged training configuration and prompts were retained. Old manifests and source remain identifiable in git history.
experiments.limitation: Prototype inspection exposed related authored scenarios during development. The final frozen split controls scenario-family overlap but is not an independently collected blind external dataset.
